'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Woody McClure LS Mind What You Have Learned (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Woody McClure]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned (V) / Save You It Can (V)|VB6-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Woody M
* '''Deck name:''' Minding the Mains
* '''Username:''' McClure
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
